# Atom Shop

 Every week on Tuesday and often Friday, items are now available in the Fallout 76 in-game Atom Shop. In this category we archive the screenshots of the respective offers for you. This means you can still check what was on offer months later. The range of items in Fallout 76 is only based on offers; unfortunately there is no fixed range.
